    Our FAQ's

    Why is Cloud different from a standard multivitamin?

    Standard multivitamins were designed for people eating normally - they don't account for the specific deficiencies GLP-1 medications create. Cloud is built around the exact nutritional gaps jab users face.


    Fibre for gut support, B-vitamins for energy when you're eating less, biotin and zinc for hair and a gummy format that doesn't trigger nausea the way pills and powders can.

    Can I take Cloud on jab day when I'm feeling nauseous?

    Yes - this is exactly why Cloud exists as a gummy. Protein shakes, meal replacements, and even large capsules can be impossible on nausea days. Cloud's small, cloud-shaped gummies are easy to stomach when everything else feels impossible. Many of our customers make it a specific jab-day ritual.

    What does Cloud actually taste like?

    Cloud Greens Gummies are delicious - not in a "supplement-trying-to-be-nice" way, but genuinely enjoyable. Wild Strawberry flavour with clean greens. No chalky aftertaste. No chemical sweetener tang. The whole point is that you'll actually want to take them every day.

    Is Cloud suitable for all GLP-1 medications?

    Cloud is designed for anyone on a GLP-1 receptor agonist - including Mounjaro (tirzepatide), Ozempic (semaglutide), Wegovy, Rybelsus, and other weight management jabs.


    Always check with your prescribing clinician before adding any supplement to your routine.

    What are the ingredients? Are there allergens?

    Cloud contains 36+ ingredients including organic kale, spinach, spirulina, chlorella, wheatgrass, blueberry, acai, goji, super mushrooms, and 20+ vitamins and minerals. Cloud is vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free, nut-free, and uses no synthetic dyes or artificial sweeteners. Made with a pectin base - no gelatin.

    How does the subscription work?

    Your Cloud subscription delivers a fresh 28-serving pouch every 4 weeks.


    You're billed automatically and can pause, delay, or cancel any time through your account - no hidden fees, no penalties, no awkward cancellation hoops.
